item.title: Three Major New Games Have Added Free Xbox Trials And Demos
item.description:
All of them well worth a play.

We don't tend to highlight demos and trials on the Xbox Store all that often, but when you get multiple recent releases (some of them AAA) suddenly getting freebies, they definitely can't go unmentioned!

The three games we're talking about in particular here are Control Resonant, Crimson Desert Enhanced and Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival. The first two have free trials (and we actually mentioned the Crimson Desert one in a separate article back in October), while Hellraiser: Revival has a free new demo.

Read the full article on purexbox.com

item.title: Xbox Unveils New Halo Background & Default 'Event' Background For GTA 6
item.description:
If you're seeing it, now you know why.

If you've turned on your Xbox console today and been presented with a background for GTA 6 without selecting it, there's a reason for that. Xbox is promoting the game by making a default "event" background for certain people.

You can let it sit there and do its thing if you want (although unfortunately it's not dynamic), or you can turn it off by going to Settings, Personalisation, My Background and then unticking the "show event-themed backgrounds" box.

Read the full article on purexbox.com

item.title: Multiple Games Are Available Today On Xbox, Including One With GTA & Zelda Inspirations (November 18)
item.description:
Plus three Xbox Game Pass Premium titles.

Just in case you wanted a break from the GTA news, we thought we'd remind you that we've got a few games either releasing or being added to Xbox Game Pass today, and there's some interesting stuff in the mix here.

The one that catches the eye is Vice: Magic City Mayhem, which we mentioned recently in our article about two Vice City games releasing in mid-November. While the cover art is very GTA-inspired, and it's set in a world with a "Vice City theme", it actually appears to have more in common with classic Zelda in terms of the gameplay style.

Read the full article on purexbox.com
